components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main administrative action with deep mineral fill and restrained lift.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid transparent; padding: 0 18px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; border-radius: 8px; color: #fff; background: var(--mineral-dark); font-family: "Onest Variable", sans-serif; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; transition: background .18s ease, transform .18s ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #314f52; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(102,129,132,.34); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet outlined action for cancellation, preview, and lower-priority choices.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid #cad4cf; padding: 0 18px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--ink); background: transparent; font-family: "Onest Variable", sans-serif; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; transition: background .18s ease, border-color .18s ease, transform .18s ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: #e9eeeb; border-color: #b7c3bd; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(102,129,132,.34); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform: none; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: The standard white dashboard field with a cool hairline stroke.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #34413e; font-family: "Onest Variable", sans-serif; font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 46px; color: var(--ink); background: #fff; border: 1px solid #cbd4cf; border-radius: 7px; padding: 12px 13px; font: 450 1rem "Onest Variable", sans-serif; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #7b8783; opacity: 1; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #b7c3bd; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(102,129,132,.34); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Dashboard Navigation
components.description: A quiet vertical navigation row whose current destination becomes a deep mineral field.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 5px; font-family: "Onest Variable", sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { min-height: 46px; padding: 0 13px; display: flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 7px; color: #53615e; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 570; } .ds-nav a:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.55); } .ds-nav a.active { color: #fff; background: var(--mineral-dark); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(102,129,132,.34); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav a:active { background: #314f52; }

components.name: Segmented Filter
components.description: A compact outlined status filter with one lightly lifted white selection.
components.css: .ds-segmented { width: fit-content; display: flex; gap: 3px; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; font-family: "Onest Variable", sans-serif; } .ds-segmented button { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; } .ds-segmented button:hover { color: var(--ink); } .ds-segmented button.active { color: var(--ink); background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 2px 7px rgba(39,54,49,.08); } .ds-segmented button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(102,129,132,.34); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-segmented button:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Guest Status
components.description: Text-supported delivery states in restrained sand and green fields.
components.html: Belum dikirimTerkirim
components.css: .ds-statuses { display: flex; gap: 8px; font-family: "Onest Variable", sans-serif; } .ds-status { width: fit-content; padding: 5px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-unsent { color: #725b31; background: #f3ead3; } .ds-sent { color: #315d51; background: #deece6; }

components.name: Invitation Opening Action
components.description: The cover's translucent pill action with a pearl circular arrow endpoint.
components.css: .ds-open-invitation { min-height: 50px; padding: 0 7px 0 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.58); border-radius: 40px; color: #fff; background: rgba(25,43,40,.2); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 15px; font: 650 1rem "Onest Variable", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .18s ease, transform .18s ease; } .ds-open-invitation span { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--mineral-dark); background: #f3f7f3; } .ds-open-invitation:hover { background: rgba(25,43,40,.38); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-open-invitation:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(240,247,242,.55); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-open-invitation:active { transform: none; }

narrative.overview:
Stillwater Letters treats the interface as pearl paper lifted from moving water. Mineral pigment, fine concentric lines, documentary photography, low-contrast surfaces, and generous open space create a personal editorial character rather than a stack of decorative wedding cards.

The public invitation carries the most expressive scale and motion, while the administration surfaces stay quiet, direct, and structurally legible. Across both, Bricolage Grotesque supplies the human display voice, Onest carries utility copy, and photography remains the emotional focus.
keyCharacteristics: Cool pearl and paper surfaces with mineral blue-green emphasis.
Oversized, tightly tracked display typography beside compact utility labels.
Hairline dividers and tonal fields instead of boxed card stacks.
Concentric and irregular ripple outlines as the recurring signature.
Restrained motion that opens, drifts, or pulses like disturbed water.

rules.name: The Mineral Restraint Rule
rules.body: Deep mineral marks the active path and major editorial fields; it does not flood every control.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Bricolage Grotesque for expressive hierarchy and Onest for reading and operation; do not introduce a third typographic voice.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Lists, sections, and resting controls use lines and tonal layering; shadows are reserved for state, overlay, or physical-object cues.

dos: Do let pearl space, hairlines, and typography establish hierarchy before adding containers.
Do keep public actions comfortable at phone scale with at least the observed 44px touch target.
Do use ripple outlines as restrained structural accents and motion cues.
Do let real photography carry the invitation's emotion.
donts: Don't replace the editorial section flow with a generic stack of floral wedding cards.
Don't add decorative dashboard cards where a line, row, or tonal field already provides structure.
Don't spread shadows across resting surfaces.
Don't introduce saturated accent colors or a third font voice into the observed system.
